1.explanation: • lighthouse-core/audits/unsized-images.js defines the unsized-images audit, builds the details table rows, and currently emits the remote URL into a thumbnail column. We need to add FullPageScreenshot to its requiredArtifacts, change the table item for thumbnails to include the element’s DOM node id, and pass the elementRect along so it can render a local screenshot sub-image instead. • report/renderer/details-renderer.js is the code that turns a TableItemValue of itemType 'thumbnail' into an `` element. We must detect fullPageScreenshot is present and override the thumbnail renderer to call ElementScreenshotRenderer.render(...) with the element’s rect, instead of hot-linking the URL. • report/renderer/element-screenshot-renderer.js contains the logic to take a fullPageScreenshot artifact and a DOM node’s rect (dataset) to generate a clipped preview. We may need to expose or adjust its public API so details-renderer can use it for the unsized-images table. • lighthouse-core/gather/gatherers/full-page-screenshot.js is the gatherer that produces the fpss artifact (data + width + height). It must remain accurate and available as an artifact to the report so that the rendering layer can extract sub-images for thumbnails.
1.bug_scenario: When the “Image elements do not have explicit `width` and `height`” audit runs, the report’s details table shows a thumbnail column that simply hot-links the original image URLs off the remote server. This fails CSP/mixed-content policies and leaks external requests. The goal is to replace those `` hot-links with locally-generated thumbnails cropped from the full-page screenshot (fpss) and embedded as data URIs, avoiding any remote image requests.
